paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma at פ״ג-ז.

notes.text: The short locator פ״ג-ז does not identify a Tanchuma parashah or edition; its exact target remains to be checked.

The earlier local rendering “(3:7)” is withdrawn as an unverified interpretation. The source supplies פ״ג-ז without a Tanchuma parashah or edition. “He” follows the heading; the literal locator is retained without a verified numeric expansion.
Hyman gives no parashah or edition for this citation. We could not identify the passage naming Rabbi Aviah in the Tanchuma witnesses we were able to consult.
